_comment: G-8: every display string in the game, English only in MVP. Keys are ui_<screen>_<element> or n_<event>_title/_body (doc 08's event ids). Full table is authored alongside the screens; the entries below fix the conventions and the load-bearing templates.
_source: docs/design/12-ui-ux.md §3.1 + §8. Placeholders are {named} only — never positional %s. Lookup is Str.t(key, args). A missing key returns the key itself in a debug build and is a test failure (doc 12 test 21).
ui_overlay_disabled: {name} overlay: this system is not in the build yet.
ui_overlay_active: {name} overlay is on. Tap again to turn it off.
ui_settings_sound_hint: Audio lands later; this remembers your level.
ui_saves_failed: That did not work — nothing changed.
ui_pause_quit_confirm: Quit? Your city is saved first.
ui_requirement_power_capacity: Electrical capacity insufficient: {have} available / {need} required at {at}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_water_pressure: Water pressure insufficient: {have} at this block / {need} required. {remedy}
ui_requirement_no_road: No road access: nearest road is {have} tiles away. Build a road to this parcel.
ui_requirement_no_crew: No construction crew free: {have} / {need} crews busy. {remedy}
ui_requirement_fire_coverage: Fire coverage missing: nearest station {have} (max {need} for Level 3+). {remedy}
ui_requirement_city_level: City level too low: Level {need} required, you are Level {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_occupied: Tile occupied: {have} is already built on. Demolish it or choose another tile.
ui_requirement_undeveloped: Block not developed: run the 6 development phases on {at} first.
ui_requirement_terrain: Terrain unsuitable: {have}. Choose flatter or drier ground.
ui_requirement_e_avenue: Avenue access insufficient: nearest avenue {have} tiles from the access tile / {need} tiles required for Level {level}. Upgrade this block's boundary road to an AVENUE, or build one within {need} tiles.
ui_requirement_e_unserved: No electrical service: no transformer reaches tile {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_state: Building busy: it is {have}, and only an active building can be upgraded. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_condition: Condition too low: {have} / {need} required to upgrade. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_max_level: Already at Level {have} of {need} — the highest this building goes.
ui_requirement_e_unknown_building: That building is no longer on the map. {remedy}
ui_requirement_power_capacity_remedy: Upgrade {at}, or add a second feeder.
ui_requirement_water_pressure_remedy: Add a pumping station or a storage tank in this district.
ui_requirement_no_road_remedy: Build a road to this parcel.
ui_requirement_no_crew_remedy: Wait for a crew to free up, or build a Construction Yard.
ui_requirement_fire_coverage_remedy: Build a fire station in this district.
ui_requirement_city_level_remedy: Grow the city to Level {need} to unlock it.
ui_requirement_funds_remedy: Wait for tax revenue, or sell something first.
ui_requirement_occupied_remedy: Demolish what is there, or choose another tile.
ui_requirement_not_owned_remedy: Buy the block from the Land tab first.
ui_requirement_undeveloped_remedy: Run the 6 development phases on this block first.
ui_requirement_tech_lock_remedy: Reach the required city level first.
ui_requirement_e_avenue_remedy: Upgrade this block's boundary road to an AVENUE.
ui_requirement_e_unserved_remedy: Place a transformer within reach, or build closer to the grid.
ui_requirement_e_state_remedy: Wait for the current job to finish, or repair it first.
ui_requirement_e_max_level_remedy: Nothing to fix — this is the top of the ladder.
ui_requirement_e_unknown_archetype_remed: Pick a card from the build sheet.
ui_requirement_e_unknown_building_remedy: Close this panel and pick another building.
ui_requirement_unknown_remedy: Open the requirement list for details.
ui_coach_review_ledger: Your city just earned money. Tap TREASURY to see where it comes from.
n_outage_major_body: {district} lost power at {time}. {units} crews are responding.
n_component_tripped_body: Protection opened at {time}; it may reclose on its own.
n_load_shed_body: {kw} kW dropped at {time} to keep the grid up.
n_treasury_low_body: Balance {balance}. The credit line is paying your bills now.
n_treasury_critical_body: Balance {balance}. Spending is blocked until income recovers.
n_land_developed_body: You can build on it now.
